subject.title: marketplace-crons: MercadoLibre degrada listings por image-validator-404 en Bunny CDN

question: Is the current post-PR-6503/6635 production signal enough to close this MercadoLibre `IMAGE_NOT_FOUND` issue, or should it stay open for a preflight/backfill fix?
rationale: Source now contains plausible mitigations, but the issue's latest production evidence says the pattern was still live after earlier fixes and no later production proof is recorded in the thread.

options.title: Verify production before closing
options.body: Run the BigQuery check for `/api/mercadolibre` after the latest deploy and close only if `IMAGE_NOT_FOUND` no longer re-enters create for selected stocks.

options.title: Implement preflight/backfill
options.body: If the signal remains live, add or run the narrow eligibility/backfill path that prevents known missing-image stocks from being discovered one by one by create.

options.title: Accept current one-time rejection
options.body: If operations accepts first-seen ineligible rows with HTTP 200 as expected behavior, document that boundary and close this issue with the production evidence.

recommendation.title: Verify production before closing
recommendation.body: Run the BigQuery check for `/api/mercadolibre` after the latest deploy and close only if `IMAGE_NOT_FOUND` no longer re-enters create for selected stocks.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to Alex and Alex carried the earlier formal fixes for this exact issue.
